operation.instructions: Use selectedTarget.position and selectedTarget.stickers for the current case. Its id is an immutable name and says NOTHING about its current position or orientation. Choose one useful setup/routine for the selected goal and target. Read current stickers and the routine conditions. Use the recognised situation as context. During gather, gain a petal or stage this target for its next lift while protecting existing petals. During transfer, align the target or insert it. Do not move an already solved bottom edge. U-only setup is allowed when it prepares this target. Never assume an action outcome was checked by code.

edges: Edge DF is at DR. yellow faces D; green faces R.

state.reference: All observation face names and routine moves are local to front=L. Piece IDs are identities, not current positions. U/D unchanged.

operation.instructions: Use selectedTarget.position and selectedTarget.stickers for the current case. Its id is an immutable name and says NOTHING about its current position or orientation. Choose one useful setup/routine for the selected goal and target. Read current stickers and the routine conditions. Use the recognised situation as context. During gather, gain a petal or stage this target for its next lift while protecting existing petals. During transfer, align the target or insert it. Do not move an already solved bottom edge. U-only setup is allowed when it prepares this target. Never assume an action outcome was checked by code.

frame.note: Fixed frame: yellow D, white U. Clockwise is viewed directly at the turned face. Camera has no effect.

edges: Edge DF is at BR. yellow faces R; green faces B.
Edge DR is at UF. yellow faces U; red faces F.
Edge DB is at DF. yellow faces D; blue faces F.
Edge DL is at DR. yellow faces D; orange faces R.

state.reference: All observation face names and routine moves are local to front=F. Piece IDs are identities, not current positions. U/D unchanged.

operation.instructions: Use selectedTarget.position and selectedTarget.stickers for the current case. Its id is an immutable name and says NOTHING about its current position or orientation. Choose one useful setup/routine for the selected goal and target. Read current stickers and the routine conditions. Use the recognised situation as context. During gather, gain a petal or stage this target for its next lift while protecting existing petals. During transfer, align the target or insert it. Do not move an already solved bottom edge. U-only setup is allowed when it prepares this target. Never assume an action outcome was checked by code.

frame.note: Fixed frame: yellow D, white U. Clockwise is viewed directly at the turned face. Camera has no effect.

edges: Edge DF is at UR. yellow faces U; green faces R.
Edge DR is at UF. yellow faces F; red faces U.
Edge DB is at UL. yellow faces U; blue faces L.
Edge DL is at BL. yellow faces L; orange faces B.

state.reference: All observation face names and routine moves are local to front=L. Piece IDs are identities, not current positions. U/D unchanged.

operation.instructions: Use selectedTarget.position and selectedTarget.stickers for the current case. Its id is an immutable name and says NOTHING about its current position or orientation. Choose one useful setup/routine for the selected goal and target. Read current stickers and the routine conditions. Use the recognised situation as context. During gather, gain a petal or stage this target for its next lift while protecting existing petals. During transfer, align the target or insert it. Do not move an already solved bottom edge. U-only setup is allowed when it prepares this target. Never assume an action outcome was checked by code.

state.reference: All observation face names and routine moves are local to front=R. Piece IDs are identities, not current positions. U/D unchanged.

operation.instructions: Use selectedTarget.position and selectedTarget.stickers for the current case. Its id is an immutable name and says NOTHING about its current position or orientation. Choose one useful setup/routine for the selected goal and target. Read current stickers and the routine conditions. Use the recognised situation as context. During gather, gain a petal or stage this target for its next lift while protecting existing petals. During transfer, align the target or insert it. Do not move an already solved bottom edge. U-only setup is allowed when it prepares this target. Never assume an action outcome was checked by code.

operation.instructions: Use selectedTarget.position and selectedTarget.stickers for the current case. Its id is an immutable name and says NOTHING about its current position or orientation. During gather, gain a petal or stage this target for its next lift while protecting existing petals. During transfer, align the target or insert it. Do not move an already solved bottom edge. operation.instructions: Use selectedTarget.position and selectedTarget.stickers for the current case. Its id is an immutable name and says NOTHING about its current position or orientation. Choose one useful setup/routine for the selected goal and target. Read current stickers and the routine conditions. Use the recognised situation as context. During gather, gain a petal or stage this target for its next lift while protecting existing petals. During transfer, align the target or insert it. Do not move an already solved bottom edge. U-only setup is allowed when it prepares this target. Never assume an action outcome was checked by code.

frame.note: Fixed frame: yellow D, white U. Clockwise is viewed directly at the turned face. Camera has no effect.

edges: Edge DF is at DB. yellow faces D; green faces B.
Edge DR is at UF. yellow faces U; red faces F.
Edge DB is at UR. yellow faces U; blue faces R.
Edge DL is at UB. yellow faces U; orange faces B.

state.reference: All observation face names and routine moves are local to front=B. Piece IDs are identities, not current positions. U/D unchanged.

operation.instructions: Use selectedTarget.position and selectedTarget.stickers for the current case. Its id is an immutable name and says NOTHING about its current position or orientation. Choose one useful setup/routine for the selected goal and target. Read current stickers and the routine conditions. Use the recognised situation as context. During gather, gain a petal or stage this target for its next lift while protecting existing petals. During transfer, align the target or insert it. Do not move an already solved bottom edge. U-only setup is allowed when it prepares this target. Never assume an action outcome was checked by code.
